messages.subject: define functions in global.R
parts:
Hey guys,

I have run into a weird situation. I have defined my own functions in the global.R file and there was problem of quoting it in server.R. This morning I have modified my server.R and ui.R (simply change the name of some of my outputs), then re-uploaded ui.R and server.R to Amazon EC2. However, this time the web page returned an error message saying that it can't find the function I defined. So I moved all the functions to server.R then problem is resolved. Anyone knows why this is the case?

Thank you,

Su
